import re
import sys

values = {}
pattern = re.compile(r"\s*(a|b|TMP)\s*<-\s*(\d+)\s*;\s*")

for line in sys.stdin:
    match = pattern.fullmatch(line)
    if match:
        variable, expression = match.groups()
        values[variable] = values[expression] if expression in values else int(expression)

print(f"a ?= {values['a']}; b ?= {values['b']}; TMP ?= {values['TMP']};")
